layout: named rectangles; do not divide this image into an automatic 4x2 grid
coordinateConvention: rect is [x,y,width,height]; anchor is [x,y] relative to rect, at the body centre and lowest visible foot. Use a single scale based on nominalStandingHeight for all poses.
notes: Image bytes and alpha channel are preserved exactly as generated; no raster postprocessing was performed.
The slash extends beyond an equal-width third cell, so its named rectangle is deliberately wider.
Visual bounds use alpha >= 32 to ignore near-transparent generative specks; frame rectangles add six pixels padding. No visible sprite edge touches a frame boundary.
The two contact poses are similar; this is an eight-pose starter atlas, not a complete high-frame-rate production animation set.
Anchors are authored from visible body centre and foot sole; renderer collision feet should use the supplied anchors, not the padded image bottom.
